U.S. Department of Justice 

Office of the Solicitor General 

Washington, D.C. 20530 

November 19, 2018 

Honorable Scott S. Harris 
Clerk 
Supreme Court of the United States 
Washington. D.C. 20543 

Re: United States v. Andre Ralph Haymond, No. 17-1672 

Dear Mr. Harris: 

The Court granted the petition for a writ of certiorari in this case on October 26, 2018. 

Petitioner's brief on the merits is currently due December 10, 2018. 

In order to accommodate scheduling difficulties and the press of other cases, petitioner 
respectfully requests, under Rule 30.4 of the Rules of this Court, an extension to and including 
December 17, 2018, within which to file the opening brief and joint appendix. Because of similar 
concerns, counsel for respondent consents to that request and seeks an extension of time for the 
filing of respondent's briefs to and including January 18, 2019. Petitioner consents to that request. 

Sincerely, 

Noel J. Francisco 
Solicitor General
